content.text:
I've submitted index 8 (Bi 0.094, Cu 0.443, V 0.463) as the best composition. It had the highest photocurrent of the three I measured. The campaign is finished, but with only three of 188 compositions measured, it may not be the best in the library.

| Index | Bi / Cu / V | Photocurrent (A) |
|---|---|---|
| 8 | 0.094 / 0.443 / 0.463 | 4.76e-5 |
| 119 | 0.081 / 0.497 / 0.423 | 4.30e-5 |
| 143 | 0.358 / 0.208 / 0.434 | 2.29e-5 |

- **Choosing the first two:** I measured one composition from the bismuth-vanadate-rich region (143) and one from the copper-vanadium-rich, low-bismuth region (8). Index 8 gave about twice the photocurrent of 143.
- **The third measurement:** I moved further in the same direction, with more copper and less bismuth (119). It came in slightly below index 8, so the best spot seems to be near a 1:1 copper-to-vanadium ratio with little bismuth.
- **XRD:** I used three of the five XRD scans, on 143, 8 and 13. They didn't separate the two regions clearly: all three share the strongest peak (Q ≈ 2.04 Å⁻¹, where bismuth vanadate's main peak sits) and many other peaks. The scans didn't affect which compositions I measured next. Index 13's pattern closely matched 143's, so I didn't spend a measurement on it.
